description:
Payload for a CRUD-emitted updated event. Contains a field-level diff
recording which fields changed and their before/after values.

Emitted automatically by the mock server on every PATCH request.
Consumers can react to specific field mutations without fetching the
full resource.

changes.description: List of fields that changed, with before and after values.

items.description: A single field change recorded in an updated event.

field.description: Dot-path of the changed field. Top-level fields are a simple name (e.g. `status`); nested fields use dot notation (e.g. `personalInformation.dateOfBirth`). Arrays are treated as leaf values — the path identifies the array field itself, not individual elements.

before.description: Value of the field before the update.

after.description: Value of the field after the update.
